itemized_matrix_assessment.name: Thực đơn & Combo F&B (Jollibee)
itemized_matrix_assessment.ux_rationale: F&B combo pricing is subject to rapid promotional turnarounds. 7-day fresh window ensures user trust; 8-14 days warning prevents deceptive promotion claims.

itemized_matrix_assessment.name: Giá vé rạp chiếu phim (Galaxy, Metiz)
itemized_matrix_assessment.ux_rationale: Cinema ticket tariffs rotate on weekly theatrical release cycles (Friday to Thursday). 7 days aligns with consumer schedule expectations.

itemized_matrix_assessment.name: Linh kiện & Phụ kiện Công nghệ (Phi Long, Điện Máy Xanh)
itemized_matrix_assessment.ux_rationale: Retail computer accessories have 2-week promotion runs. 14 days fresh / 30 days hold is consistent with consumer hardware shopping patterns.

itemized_matrix_assessment.name: Chính sách Hội viên & Tích điểm (Phúc Long)
itemized_matrix_assessment.ux_rationale: Loyalty point accrual and redemption policies are quarterly program rules. 30 days fresh / 90 days warning matches quarterly audit cadence.
